```plato
//==
// # Images
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Images
//  - IImage containers

//==
// # Images
//
// Raster data: rectangular grids of pixels. The `IImage` interface
// (`images.concepts.plato`) exposes only dimensions; pixel access lives on the
// concrete types below because pixel representations differ (bytes, floats,
// indices, bits). Unless a type says otherwise, pixel storage is row-major
// starting at the top-left pixel, and a pixel array's Count equals Width times
// Height. Encoded, tiled, animated, and volumetric containers follow in the
// next section.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - UV origin (origin top-left, V increases
// downward; ImageOrigin.BottomLeft is the opt-in OpenGL order).

// Where pixel row zero sits in an image's coordinate convention: scanline
// order as in most codecs (TopLeft), or OpenGL texture order (BottomLeft).
type ImageOrigin = TopLeft | BottomLeft;
```
